AUDIT GPT-6.1 Sol — growth-project-backend#664 @ 62f57edbdb6030e69749292cdadeac76c591e34d — VERDICT: APPROVE

Independent first **T3 dependency audit**; **open A/B/C = 0/0/1**. All 11 required checks are green at this exact head. Read the complete four-file own diff relative to its actual main base `2e3094b9`, not the reverse diff against later #608 main; its main merge reconstructs the exact automatic tree. No new app upload, auth, tenant, migration or CI-gate edit is introduced. ([READY record](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/664#issuecomment-5964724472), [candidate](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/664))

The override remains scoped to `@nestjs/platform-express@11.1.26`, now pins multer **2.4.0**, and the real-consumer compatibility probe raises both the reviewed-major floor and exact resolved expectation rather than weakening either. The advisory identifies affected `>=2.2.0,<2.4.0`, patched 2.4.0, and aborted disk-upload orphaning; the release also documents limit/filter/error/stream-handler changes. No `FileInterceptor`/multiple-file interceptor/`MulterModule`/multer import is wired under this candidate's `src`; the HelloSign route retains its own signed raw-body multipart parser. Thus no app upload-path behavior change triggers T4 here. ([Override and lock](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/62f57edbdb6030e69749292cdadeac76c591e34d/package.json), [real-consumer test](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/62f57edbdb6030e69749292cdadeac76c591e34d/test/dependency-compatibility.spec.ts#L290-L378), [advisory](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-3pph-fpjx-jg34), [release behavior](https://github.com/expressjs/multer/releases/tag/v2.4.0), [unchanged HelloSign parser](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/62f57edbdb6030e69749292cdadeac76c591e34d/src/contracts/webhooks/hellosign-webhook.controller.ts))

Independent read-only npm registry metadata comparison confirms the lock's **version, full SHA-512 integrity, canonical tarball and dependency map** match the published 2.4.0 record. `concat-stream` and its now-unneeded `typedarray` entry are removed; remaining transitive entries become dev-only as their production path disappears, and no other resolved package version changes. The initial SDK JSON-content fetch failed; a direct read-only metadata fallback was used, with no package installation or shared-dependency mutation. ([Published metadata](https://registry.npmjs.org/multer/2.4.0), [exact lockfile](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/62f57edbdb6030e69749292cdadeac76c591e34d/package-lock.json))

### C — optional

**C-664-1 — make the body enumerate its complete harmless lock delta.** It says only `buffer-from`/`readable-stream` become dev-only and “No other entry changes,” but the same own diff also marks `safe-buffer`, `string_decoder` and `util-deprecate` dev-only and removes `typedarray`. These are consistent transitive cleanup, not a security/behavior blocker; update the acceptance inventory so the reviewed graph matches the description. ([Current body](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/664), [actual lock changes](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/664/files))

### Evidence

Local install/link/test against the older shared multer was deliberately not used as candidate acceptance because package/lock changed. Downloaded exact-head clean-`npm ci` CI executes and passes the real-consumer dependency compatibility suite and HelloSign suite; full CI reports **675 passing suites / 11,804 passing tests**, 23 skipped suites / 237 skipped tests / 5 todo. Exact-head audit gate passes with only the previously approved, dev-only/time-boxed braces exception; it is not an assertion that the whole graph contains zero high findings. Diff check clean. ([Actual build/test CI](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37089115910/job/111105459770), [actual audit CI](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37089115989/job/111105459938), [#663 audit-gate approval](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/663#issuecomment-5964436925))

Evidence: `ops/aud-sol-114b/664-{own.diff,advisory.json,release.json,registry-validation.json,build-ci.log,audit-ci.log,final-snapshot.json,verdict.md}`. Retarget/update-main and its final exact-head checks remain operator actions, not permission for this auditor to perform them. ([Candidate](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/664))

No push, merge, dispatch or production action by this auditor.

OPERATOR UPDATE-BRANCH (merge-only, agent 115) — growth-project-backend#664 @ 3e97686116ceb64a975cc209080df2d03ce81aab
Merged main ec911328 into the branch (GitHub update-branch, no conflicts). Prior verdict: GPT-6.1 Sol APPROVE at 62f57edb. Lenses: delta audit at this head once required checks are green.

AUDIT GPT-6.1 Sol — growth-project-backend#664 @ 3e97686116ceb64a975cc209080df2d03ce81aab — VERDICT: APPROVE

Independent **T3 merge-only delta**; **A/B/C = 0/0/1** (one optional carry-over, no new findings). The prior lens APPROVE at `62f57edbdb6030e69749292cdadeac76c591e34d` is re-attested at this exact head after the operator's main update. [Prior Sol verdict](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/664#issuecomment-5965294196), [operator update](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/664#issuecomment-5971586399).

**Merge purity:** candidate parents are the prior approved head and main `ec911328ab86c401b72f98f0561ebf732b3f8700`; independent `git merge-tree --write-tree` reconstructs candidate tree `a5d85d94e2438054f4c97a94e74f99ce594b18d9` exactly, without conflicts. The own diff before/after main has identical stable patch ID `42e926a38c5a888371fbd2106a529f91bdac9040`; all four dependency/doc/test files are byte-identical to the previous verdict head. [Exact candidate](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/664).

**Seam review:** #608's incoming account-deletion/export/auth/CI changes introduce no upload integration with multer, and no `FileInterceptor`, `FilesInterceptor`, `AnyFilesInterceptor`, `UploadedFile`, `MulterModule` or multer import is wired under candidate `src`. The HelloSign signed raw-body multipart parser is unchanged; the scoped 2.4.0 override, lock integrity, production graph cleanup and actual-consumer floor/probe assertions remain intact. No schema, migration, environment registration or CI gate is changed by this PR's own patch. [Candidate files](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/664/files), [previous dependency analysis](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/664#issuecomment-5965294196).

[Original C-664-1](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/664#issuecomment-5965294196).

**Exact-head evidence:** all eleven required checks pass, including clean-install build/full tests, Schema parity, npm audit, both RLS gates, MWB/community live tests, CodeQL, banned casts, SBOM and Danger. No local package install or obsolete-shared-dependency test is used as candidate evidence, and no live upload/provider/device qualification is claimed. [Build/full tests](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37140089778/job/111252531507), [Schema parity](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37140089770/job/111252531364), [npm audit](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37140089855/job/111252531750), [candidate checks](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/664/checks).

Evidence retained under `ops/aud-115/AUD-SOL-CORE/664-*`; no push, merge, workflow dispatch or production action.

AUDIT Claude Opus 5.5 — growth-project-backend#664 @ 3e97686116ceb64a975cc209080df2d03ce81aab — VERDICT: APPROVE

This is the first Opus verdict on #664, a full T3 audit plus the merge-only delta from `62f57edb` (operator update-branch 5971586399). I read the whole diff against main `ec911328`: 4 files, +18/-35. I also read the PR body and Sol's APPROVE at the earlier head `62f57edb` (5965294196).

Counts: A 0, B 0, C 1.

### Change
- **Override.** `package.json:98-99` raises the consumer-scoped override `"@nestjs/platform-express@11.1.26": { "multer": "2.4.0" }`. It stays keyed to the exact direct pin `@nestjs/platform-express 11.1.26` (`package.json:41`), so it still applies.
- **Advisory.** The GitHub advisory API confirms GHSA-3pph-fpjx-jg34 / CVE-2026-88932: medium severity, vulnerable `>= 2.2.0, < 2.4.0`, first patched `2.4.0`. So 2.4.0 is the minimal fix.
- **Lockfile.**
  - `node_modules/multer` is 2.4.0. Its integrity `sha512-7dqa0Zc...vhg==` matches `npm view multer@2.4.0 dist.integrity`. The registry dependencies (`append-field`, `busboy`, `type-is`) match the lock entry.
  - `concat-stream` and `typedarray` are removed.
  - `buffer-from`, `readable-stream`, `safe-buffer`, `string_decoder` and `util-deprecate` become `dev: true`, because concat-stream was their only production consumer.
  - No code in `src/` or `scripts/` imports any of them, so the `npm ci --omit=dev` runtime stage (`Dockerfile:86`) loses nothing it loads.
- **No multer route.** No route uses multer: `git grep` over `src/` for FileInterceptor, FilesInterceptor, AnyFilesInterceptor, FileFieldsInterceptor, UploadedFile, MulterModule and `from 'multer'` finds nothing. So the 2.4.0 edge-behaviour changes (limits checked at construction, `limits.parts` off-by-one) are not reachable today.
- **Tests and docs.**
  - `test/dependency-compatibility.spec.ts` raises the patched floor for multer major 2 and the exact resolution to `2.4.0`.
  - The multipart probe (success, truncated body, `LIMIT_FILE_SIZE`) runs against the locked 2.4.0 in CI.
  - The override register row in `docs/dependencies/2026-09-op81-dependency-repair.md` cites the advisory and release, and its removal condition now reads `multer >= 2.4.0`.

### Merge-only delta
`3e976861` = merge of `62f57edb` and main `ec911328` (#608). `git merge-tree --write-tree 62f57edb ec911328` equals the head tree, so the merge is pure and nothing beyond main's own content changed since Sol's head.

### C: optional
- **C-664-1: flaky required check at this head, now green on re-run.**
  - build-and-test at `3e976861` first failed on one test that is unrelated to this change: `test/prod-readiness/provider-wiring-twilio-aws-fly-sentry-supabase-openai-cf.spec.ts:1150`, "end-to-end: a symlink-to-token-file keeps AWS WIRED", expected WIRED, received STUB ([job 111252531507](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37140089778/job/111252531507)).
  - An audit run of the identical tree failed the same spec on two other cases that share one temp root: `:717` and `:735` ([run 37141062987](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37141062987)).
  - The operator re-run of the PR job then passed at this exact head ([job 111256251961](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37140089778/job/111256251961)). The same tree passing and failing, with different cases each time, is a nondeterministic test, not a regression.
  - That spec injects its dependency set and env directly (`scanProvidersWith(new Set(['@aws-sdk/client-s3']), ...)`), so the lockfile is not an input. The earlier head `62f57edb` (same lockfile) was green.
  - I did not isolate the root cause. Every failure is the AWS web-identity group being classified STUB for a temp-dir token path, and `classifyVars` runs `looksLikePlaceholder` and `isPathShaped` on that path value.
  - Fix rule (separate PR, outside this diff): add this spec to the flake list, and make the token path deterministic (a fixed file name under a fixed-prefix temp dir, asserting `classifyVars` buckets it present) so it cannot vary per run.

### Evidence
- CI at `3e976861`: all 11 required checks pass after the build-and-test re-run. npm audit (high+critical, whole graph) is green, so the advisory is gone from the graph.
- Method: code and lockfile read at the exact head, plus one CI run on an audit branch (since deleted). No local suites. Nothing pushed to the PR branch.
